scripts.build: npm run build -w @vamosdalian/gitgraph-core && npm run build -w @vamosdalian/gitgraph-js && npm run build -w @vamosdalian/gitgraph-react && npm run build -w @vamosdalian/gitgraph-node
scripts.format: prettier --write README.md CONTRIBUTING.md package.json tsconfig.json jest.config.cjs eslint.config.mjs .github/workflows packages/gitgraph-{core,js,node,react}/{package.json,tsconfig.json,rollup.config.mjs,README.md,src}
scripts.format:check: prettier --check README.md CONTRIBUTING.md package.json tsconfig.json jest.config.cjs eslint.config.mjs .github/workflows packages/gitgraph-{core,js,node,react}/{package.json,tsconfig.json,rollup.config.mjs,README.md,src}
scripts.pack:check: npm pack --dry-run -w @vamosdalian/gitgraph-core && npm pack --dry-run -w @vamosdalian/gitgraph-js && npm pack --dry-run -w @vamosdalian/gitgraph-react && npm pack --dry-run -w @vamosdalian/gitgraph-node
scripts.test:ci: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test && npm run pack:check
